component.name: Prefixr
component.summary: Run Windows games with Wine and Proton

description.p: Prefixr manages Wine and Proton prefixes for Windows games on Linux: add a game, pick a runner, and start it. It downloads Proton-GE, Wine and umu-launcher itself, applies the game's protonfixes, and sets up DXVK, MangoHud, Gamescope and GameMode per game.

ul.li: A library with artwork from SteamGridDB, categories and play time
Games from Epic Games, GOG and Amazon Games
Shortcuts for the desktop, the start menu and Steam
A command line for scripts and AI agents
